Tests that Debugger.evaluateOnCallFrame respects the TDZ of module bindings.
Paused in a function, bindings in TDZ:
  exportedLet => throws ReferenceError: exportedLet is not defined
  typeof exportedLet => throws ReferenceError: exportedLet is not defined
  exportedConst => throws ReferenceError: exportedConst is not defined
  ExportedClass => throws ReferenceError: ExportedClass is not defined
  importedLet => throws ReferenceError: importedLet is not defined
  exportedLet = 4 => throws ReferenceError: exportedLet is not defined
  exportedConst = 4 => throws ReferenceError: exportedConst is not defined
  importedLet = 4 => throws ReferenceError: importedLet is not defined
  param = exportedLet => throws ReferenceError: exportedLet is not defined
  param = importedLet, param = 5 => throws ReferenceError: importedLet is not defined
  param => 1
Paused at module top-level, bindings in TDZ:
  exportedLet => throws ReferenceError: exportedLet is not defined
  importedLet => throws ReferenceError: importedLet is not defined
  exportedLet = 4 => throws ReferenceError: exportedLet is not defined
  readParam() => 1
Paused at module top-level, initialized:
  exportedLet => 2
  importedLet => 2
  exportedConst => 3
  typeof ExportedClass => function
  exportedLet = 4 => 4
  importedLet => 4
  exportedConst = 4 => throws TypeError: Assignment to constant variable.
  importedLet = 5 => throws TypeError: Assignment to constant variable.
  readParam() => 1
